In January 2026, the UK government reported a surplus of £30.4 billion. This figure was £15.9 billion higher than the surplus recorded in January 2025 and £6.3 billion above the Office for Budget Responsibility's forecast. The surplus was attributed to increased revenues from capital gains tax, National Insurance contributions, and income tax. 

FINAL: £30.4 billion
